prompt: When will a bus-pass claim submitted on Saturday appear in pay?
promptZh: 星期六送出的公車月票補助申請，會在哪個月的薪資入帳？

options.text: In this month’s pay without any further action
options.zh: 不必另做處理，會在本月薪資入帳
options.whyZh: 星期五之後才送出，不能列入本月薪資。

options.text: In this month’s pay if the pass covers Saturday
options.zh: 若月票星期六有效，就會列入本月薪資
options.whyZh: 決定入帳月份的是申請日，不是月票有效日。

options.text: Only after a parking request is approved
options.zh: 停車補助申請核准後才入帳
options.whyZh: 兩項申請需分開，未說月票要等停車申請。
星期六晚於星期五的截止日，應列入下個月薪資。

evidence: Claims submitted by Friday will appear in this month's pay; later claims will go into next month's pay.
explanationZh: 星期六晚於星期五的截止日，應列入下個月薪資。
difficultyRationale: Apply an inclusive payroll cutoff to a weekday not spoken.

vocabulary.zh: 最遲於星期五提交的申請
vocabulary.note: by + 截止時間通常含該時點；逾期則進入不同處理週期。
